notes: Printed: 'Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. If this spell was cast from anywhere other than your hand, put each of those cards into your hand instead.' Seat 0 casts it from its graveyard by a test permission (test_permission_cast; the card gives no permission of its own). The 'instead' replaces the whole first instruction: all three looked-at cards (Library 5, 4 and 3) go to the hand, nothing goes to the bottom, and nothing is chosen or ordered, so the step carries no decision words. The sorcery then goes to its owner's graveyard. Fixed 2026-11-17 (it was a known bug since 2026-11-13): the tree ran the normal outcome first and then moved one card (template B5b-cast-elsewhere-instead, now the 'instead' arm Conditional(not cast from your hand, every looked-at card, else=the split)), and the Conditional, run while the look window is open, judged the cast history of the looked-at card instead of the spell's (Executor._run_effect).
